summary: The search test checks whether a regex matches anywhere in a string using Python's re.search.
questions: How do I check if a string contains a regex pattern anywhere?
What's the difference between search and match tests?

answer_card.title: search test (unanchored regex)
answer_card.answer_md: `string is search(pattern)` uses Python `re.search`, so the pattern can match anywhere (unlike `match`, which is anchored at the start).
